findings.title: Reminder cancellations are fire-and-forget in booking cancellation
findings.body: The cancellation loop calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder but never awaits the returned promises. The request can return before the database update setting cancelled=true or the Twilio cancellation completes, especially in serverless environments where the function may be frozen after the response. As a result, reminders for cancelled bookings can still be sent.

findings.title: Reschedule endpoint does not await reminder cancellations
findings.body: In requestReschedule, workflow reminder cancellations are started inside forEach without collecting or awaiting the promises. The mutation can complete before the reminder rows are marked cancelled or external SMS/email cancellations finish, so reminders for the rescheduled/cancelled booking may still be delivered.

findings.title: Workflow deletion cancels external reminders without awaiting completion
findings.body: When deleting a workflow, scheduled reminder cancellations are fired in a forEach and then the workflow is deleted immediately. Because the cancellation promises are not awaited, the workflow and its reminder rows can be deleted before SendGrid/Twilio cancellation completes. If an external cancellation fails, there may be no reminder row left to retry from, and the scheduled message can still be sent.

findings.title: Workflow update does not await step/reminder mutation promises
findings.body: The update endpoint uses userWorkflow.steps.map(async ...) but never awaits the resulting promises. Step deletion/update, reminder cancellation, and creation of replacement reminders may continue after the mutation returns. This can leave the workflow partially updated and can silently drop cancellation or scheduling work if the process ends.

findings.title: Reschedule cancellation uses immediate SendGrid cancel but leaves no retryable DB state
findings.body: For a reschedule, previous email reminders are cancelled with deleteScheduledEmailReminder(..., true). That immediateDelete path only calls SendGrid and returns without deleting the WorkflowReminder or setting cancelled=true. The loop is also not awaited. If the SendGrid cancellation fails or the request ends before it completes, there is no cancelled flag for the cron job to retry, so the old booking's reminder can still be sent.

findings.title: One failed SendGrid cancellation aborts cancellation of all remaining reminders
findings.body: The cancellation loop awaits each SendGrid request inside a single try/catch. If any one reminder has an invalid or null referenceId, or if the SendGrid call fails, execution jumps to the catch block and the remaining reminders are not processed. The queued prisma.workflowReminder.delete promises are also not awaited in that failure path, so valid cancellations can be skipped entirely.

findings.title: Cancelled-reminder query does not ensure a SendGrid batch reference exists
findings.body: remindersToCancel is selected only by cancelled=true and scheduledDate. It does not filter method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId not null, but the following code unconditionally posts reminder.referenceId to SendGrid. A cancelled reminder without a SendGrid batch ID, or a non-email reminder with unexpected cancelled state, can cause an API error and block cancellation of subsequent reminders.

findings.title: Paid booking cancellation returns before cancelling workflow reminders
findings.body: The refund branch for paid bookings returns before the later updatedBookings.forEach blocks that cancel scheduled jobs and workflow reminders. A paid booking that is cancelled/refunded, with status changed to REJECTED, can therefore leave workflow reminders active and still trigger reminder emails or SMS.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but does not delete or mark the reminder row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true cancels the SendGrid batch but does not delete the WorkflowReminder row or set cancelled=true. Callers such as the reschedule flow rely on this to cancel old reminders. If the external cancellation fails, the database contains no state indicating cancellation, so there is no retry or cleanup path.

findings.title: Deferred cancellation can miss reminders scheduled to send soon
findings.body: The cron job only cancels reminders whose scheduledDate is within the next hour and is described as running every 15 minutes. If a booking is cancelled or rescheduled less than 15 minutes before a reminder's scheduled send time, the cron may not run before SendGrid sends the email, so the reminder can still be delivered despite the cancellation.
